summary: The broadest accessible React primitive set. It is Apache-2.0, active, React 18/19 compatible, unstyled and backed by react-aria and react-stately. The dialog spike opened with role=dialog, labelledby and focus inside the dialog; the bundle was 277.23 KB / 88.22 KB gzip. The costs are a 68 MB install with React and no npm provenance.
reasoning: Active release line: 1.22.1 published 2026-10-09; repository pushed 2026-11-03; 16k stars and 677 open issues.
Peers React 16.8-19, so React 18 and 19 are covered.
Apache-2.0 with a permissive tree: the isolated install is Apache-2.0, MIT and 0BSD packages only.
No required CSS-in-JS runtime; components are unstyled and accept className/style.
Broadest coverage in this batch: collections, tables, date/time, drag-and-drop, overlays, menus, forms and internationalization.
The React 19 dialog spike rendered role=dialog with an accessible label and moved focus inside; no install scripts and no OSV advisories.
No npm provenance; pin 1.22.1 exactly and record the gap.
The install is about 68 MB with React 19, the largest in this batch. The shipped bundle is much smaller: 277.23 KB / 88.22 KB gzip for the dialog spike.
caveats: No npm provenance. Pin exact versions and record the gap.
Large install footprint (about 68 MB with React 19), even though the browser bundle is moderate.
The dialog spike did not expose aria-modal on the role=dialog element; React Aria relies on its modal/focus behaviour. Verify the exact screen-reader output in the application.
React Aria's component APIs are more verbose than copy-paste or styled systems; expect composition work.
The package is 1.x, but the suite moves quickly; pin and test upgrades.
No local spike for tables, date/time or drag-and-drop; only the dialog path was exercised.

evidence.label: License
evidence.detail: Apache-2.0. The isolated tree is Apache-2.0, MIT and 0BSD packages only.

evidence.label: React compatibility
evidence.detail: peerDependencies react/react-dom: ^16.8.0 || ^17.0.0-rc.1 || ^18.0.0 || ^19.0.0-rc.1. The spike used React 19.2.0.

evidence.label: Dependency footprint
evidence.detail: 8 runtime dependencies including react-aria 3.53.1 and react-stately 3.51.0; about 68 MB installed with React 19; 6.8 MB unpacked.

evidence.label: Install scripts
evidence.detail: No preinstall, install or postinstall script in the isolated tree.

evidence.label: TypeScript types
evidence.detail: Bundled declarations, including the component exports and internationalization entry points.

evidence.label: Known advisories
evidence.detail: OSV returned no advisories for react-aria-components@1.22.1, react-aria@3.53.1 or react-stately@3.51.0.

evidence.label: Maintenance
evidence.detail: 1.22.1 published 2026-10-09; react-aria 3.53.1 and react-stately 3.51.0 published the same cycle; repository pushed 2026-11-03.

evidence.label: npm provenance
evidence.detail: No npm attestation for 1.22.1; published from the Adobe npm account. Pin exactly and record the gap.

evidence.label: React browser spike
evidence.detail: A Vite production build rendered an open dialog in Chrome 1200x800. The dialog had role=dialog, an accessible label and focus inside it. The JS bundle was 277.23 KB / 88.22 KB gzip including React 19.

evidence.label: Component coverage
evidence.detail: The package covers collections, tables, date/time, drag-and-drop, overlays, menus, forms, buttons and internationalization. It is the broadest headless option in this batch.
